g.title: section_fan_in_flow
g.text: Section matching with Jev and section fan-in

g.title: clean
g.text: extraction fixes audited against the PDF

g.title: roles
g.text: whole paper as cached prefix + focus heading;
"What role does this section play…? single concise sentence"

g.title: next
g.text: papers are inserted one at a time

g.title: choice2
g.text: each new section picks one node or NO_MATCH;
each node picks one new section or NO_MATCH

g.title: gate
g.text: focus paper complete; node role, its latest
paper complete, older members' sections only.
still too large → node's member sections only

g.title: pick
g.text: reverse picks use the same yes table

g.title: rank
g.text: focus paper complete; options show member
sections and roles only. Over 32k → long
context; still too large → rank each half,

g.title: recip
g.text: section picked the node and the node picked it back

g.title: fanin
g.text: one-way pick, immediately next (±1) to a core
from the same paper in that node; no chains.
Also: an old one-member node whose pick became
a core elsewhere and sits next to that core

g.title: recover
g.text: eligible: no section from its paper yet (core),
or next to a same-paper core (fan-in).
Same method as matching: Choice at paper 2,

g.title: merge
g.text: One-way and adjacent → merge as fan-in

g.title: grole
g.text: latest paper complete, other members' sections

g.title: ckpt
g.text: every Jev and Claude answer cached for --cache-from
